class: a layout fix checked by reading CSS text instead of rendering the page
origin: founding-agents-site #5 to #10: the band's head ran into step 1 at 1440 px through every review; CSS-text tests passed while the rendered page had no gutter, and #12 replaced them with a browser
summary: At 1440 px the band's head runs into step 1. The builder adds the gutter with a test that fails without it, and that still fails when the gutter is declared but no longer rendered.

issues.title: The band's head runs into step 1 at desktop width
issues.body:
At 1440 px the line "No open red issue." ends exactly at the left edge of STEP 1: there is no gutter between the head's column and the first step. Give it one at desktop widths, with a test that fails without the fix.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Files
`index.html`, `tests/`, `check.sh`

## Technical decisions
None: CSS and tests inside the existing page.
